name: flat_editorial
description: Flat editorial illustration: clean vector shapes, even confident outlines, large simple forms, one clear visual metaphor per frame, soft paper grain over flat fills
lighting: one soft directional light source, gentle shadows, no gradients beyond a single light wash
mood: calm, thoughtful, quietly confident, with generous empty space around one focal subject
avoid: any text, letters, numbers or logos
the name or look of a real artist
